seo.title: Contact – HubGet
seo.description: Write to the author of HubGet – a question, a bug, an idea or a collaboration offer. We’ll reply by email.
seo.ogDescription: Write to the author of HubGet – a question, a bug, an idea or a collaboration offer. We’ll reply by email.

texty.t3: Got a question, found a bug, or have an idea or a collaboration offer? We’ll reply by email.
texty.t14: To attach a screenshot of a bug, use the form in the app itself (Settings → Contact HubGet) after signing in.
texty.t15: The message is delivered by the Web3Forms service. We’ll only use your email to reply.
texty.t18: Thank you! The reply will go to {prvek}.
